Alignment.description: How turns and calls were matched.
Alignment.title: Alignment

ChangeView.description: A difference between two fingerprints: `None` means the item is absent on that side.
ChangeView.title: ChangeView

CheckSummary.description:
A check: how many proofs, how many FAILs, on how many files of a ticket, and on how many it passed at
once.
CheckSummary.title: CheckSummary

Compared.description: Which fingerprints exist: runs from before M1.6 have none.
Compared.title: Compared

Execution.description:
One run: the command, the fingerprint, what it spent, and how many differences it has from the previous
readable one. `readable` is false for a fingerprint of a shape this version does not know.
Execution.title: Execution

ImageRef.description:
An image returned to an instance: its position in the transcript, from 0, its media type, and whether
the dashboard serves it.
ImageRef.title: ImageRef

InstanceView.description:
An instance on the timeline, from its first call to its last. `model_ms`: the time spent with the
model.
InstanceView.title: InstanceView

Lifecycle.description:
What the registry writes into a ticket's history, proofs aside: the opening and the transitions of
`Action`. A test keeps the two aligned.
Lifecycle.title: Lifecycle

Measured.description: One call: what it cost, how much context it read, how long it waited, why it stopped.
Measured.title: Measured

Milestone.description: Up to the approved `concept` gate: what getting there cost, and how long it took.
Milestone.title: Milestone

Outcome.description: Where the project stopped: the delivery to the client, what is left to finish, the last step.
Outcome.title: Outcome

PhaseFlow.description: A phase: what it cost and how much work went back. `started_at` is its first call.
PhaseFlow.title: PhaseFlow

PhasePair.description: One phase on both sides: `None` means that side has no such phase.
PhasePair.title: PhasePair

PhaseView.description: How the model worked in one phase. The averages count only the measured calls.
PhaseView.title: PhaseView

ProjectSummary.description: A project in the list: what it cost, how many calls it made, when it worked.
ProjectSummary.title: ProjectSummary

Provenance.description:
What the projection was built from: a reader knows when, from which registry, and how complete it
is.
Provenance.title: Provenance

Refusal.description: A tool that said no, at turn `turn` of the instance, in its own words.
Refusal.title: Refusal

ReplayTurn.description:
One turn: the call that produced it, the ones discarded before it, what the model thought, wrote and
asked for, and the harness messages that follow it.
ReplayTurn.title: ReplayTurn

RoleBehaviour.description:
A role: how much context it read, how much of it came from the cache, how much it thought and
waited.
RoleBehaviour.title: RoleBehaviour

Setback.description:
A step back: a ticket sent back for rework, blocked or cancelled, after how many deliveries, and why,
in the words of whoever did it.
Setback.title: Setback

Side.description:
A project: empty `model` and `effort` mean the defaults; `None` is a project without its row, from
before M1.5.
Side.title: Side

SourceStamp.description: A file the projection is built from, as it was when read. If the file is missing, the size is empty.
SourceStamp.title: SourceStamp

Step.description: One step in a ticket's history. `setback`: a rework, a block or a cancellation.
Step.title: Step

StopCount.description: Why the model stopped writing, and how often. `complete`: the answer arrived whole.
StopCount.title: StopCount

TicketFlow.description: A ticket from its opening to its last step. `redone_usd`: what it cost after its first rework.
TicketFlow.title: TicketFlow

Turn.description: One call of an instance. Duration, TTFT and reasoning are empty when the call was not measured.
Turn.title: Turn

WaitView.description: The run stopped for a client decision: from the last call before the gate to the decision.
WaitView.title: WaitView

info.description: The read-only dashboard: the registry and the traces, through insights (ADR-0019).
info.title: Design agency: cruscotto

get.description: Two different projects, both known to the registry.
Image `index` of the transcript: only PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP, never framed or executed.

200.description: The image returned to the instance, in its own media type
